purpose: Before paid pilot generations, check whether the applicable deterministic exact-expression baseline saturates the frozen bounded reference. If 12/12, >=2/12 improvement is mathematically impossible: stop generation/confirmation, keep prototype and production diagnostics. This implements existing failure gate, not a relaxed gate.
report_mask: Replace each exact macro name with stable opaque identity only in consumer input, for every report/control; this reuses retired identity diagnostic as a safeguard for a genuinely different generator, not a new named method
names_only: Opaque symbol list and native width, no roles or source; a leakage/guessing diagnostic, not quality baseline
cost_rule: Requests with identical messages/parameters reuse previous result and SHA. No key saved. No unknown request retry. 24/60k pilot cap, original production 8/74359 already counted in parent stage.
production_width: Original module text mentions 64-bit; study common scalar input target is native size_t 64. No whole OS or target platform claim.
